information_state.reason_calibration_not_invalidated: No Stage C run existed. Revision 10 is a result-independent consistency correction discovered while implementing the exact-plan profile store. It adds no task or provider evidence.

changes.before: One newest-50 plan-outcome window also carried optional paired divergence. At the frozen 2% shadow rate it retained about one pair and could not sustain the 20-pair admission floor.
changes.after: Each exact plan has an independent newest-50 execution-outcome window and newest-50 paired-divergence window. Cost and latency use the former; admission safety uses the latter. Both reset on runtime-version drift and persist atomically.

changes.before: The planned divergence interface named a site and plan but did not bind a delayed comparison to the exact execution or runtime version that produced it.
changes.after: Every delayed comparison carries an observation token binding call-site version, complete-plan identity, runtime version, and execution sequence. Duplicate delivery is idempotent; mismatched versions or conflicting values are rejected.

changes.before: The protocol header still displayed Revision 8 after Revision 9 had been frozen and linked.
changes.after: The header displays the current Revision 10 and links both Revision 9 and Revision 10 records.

changes.before: The contract described a 24-hour exact window even though the retained windows are count-bounded and freshness is a separate admission check.
changes.after: The contract distinguishes exact count-bounded evidence windows from the 24-hour stale-profile rejection horizon.

implementation_status.runtime_scope: canonical execution-plan identity, constrained selector, and exact per-plan profile storage only; exploration, dispatch, and end-to-end evaluation remain pending

outcome_blindness_assertion: Revision 10 was frozen before any admission, calibration, pilot, or confirmatory execution. No task outcome informed this evidence-retention correction.
